neighbours.label: position where 'continue' is the expected next word (e.g. Korean object marker 을 before 계속, Japanese を before 続け)
fire: 운동 후 통증이 없으면 운동을 계속해도 된다.
グループ解散後も芸能活動を続けてきた。
彼は病気になっても仕事を続けた。
To proceed with setup, click Continue(계속) at the bottom of the window.
学生たちは夜遅くまで勉強を続けた。
quiet: 운동 후 통증이 없으면 운동을 시작해도 된다.
グループ解散後も芸能活動を辞めてしまった。
彼は病気になって仕事を休んだ。
To proceed with setup, click Install at the bottom of the window.
学生たちは夜遅くまで映画を見た。

notes: Top examples are the token right before 계속/続け/'Continue'; + output promotes 'continue' tokens. Fire is predictive (before the word), so near misses keep the same prefix and differ only in the following verb, which can't change the activation at the marker; expected to fail on near-miss leakage unless the neuron reads earlier context.
